# Merakey

> Merakey is one of the largest providers of integrated behavioral health, education, and human services across the USA, serving individuals with autism, intellectual and developmental disabilities, addiction, mental health needs, and other populations.

Founded in 1963, Merakey operates a nationwide network of 10,000+ employees delivering specialized services including ABA-based autism therapy, addiction recovery, adult and child mental health care, IDD support, foster care, aging services, and veteran assistance. The organization also operates Life Tree Pharmacy for medication management and maintains partnerships with universities and health organizations.

## Key Topics

- Behavioral Health Services
- Autism Services (ABA-based)
- Addiction Recovery & Medication-Assisted Treatment
- Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (IDD)
- Mental Health Services
- Children and Family Services
- Supported Living & Community Integration
- Life Tree Pharmacy
- Veterans Assistance
- Foster Care & Therapeutic Family Care
- Aging & Long-Term Care
- Career Opportunities
- Praesidium Safety Standards
- Multi-State Operations (Pennsylvania, California, Texas, Ohio, Virginia, Louisiana, Michigan)

## Core Services

- [Merakey Services Overview](https://www.merakey.org/services): Overview of Merakey's integrated behavioral healthcare and human services
- [Autism Services](https://www.merakey.org/services/autism): ABA-based autism services across lifespan with residential and therapy support
- [Intellectual and Developmental Disability Services](https://www.merakey.org/services/intellectual-and-developmental-disabilities-services): IDD support services including employment, living, and community integration
- [Addiction Recovery Services](https://www.merakey.org/services/addiction-recovery): Merakey's addiction recovery and medication-assisted treatment services
- [Adult Behavioral Health Services](https://www.merakey.org/services/adult-behavioral-health): Adult mental health, crisis care, and behavioral health services nationwide
- [Children and Family Services](https://www.merakey.org/services/children-and-family): Mental health and autism services for children, adolescents, and families
- [Foster Care Services](https://www.merakey.org/services/foster-care): Therapeutic Family Care program supporting child welfare and family relationships
- [Aging Services](https://www.merakey.org/services/aging): Long-term support and in-home care services for aging adults
- [Veterans Assistance Services](https://www.merakey.org/services/veterans-assistance): Fresh Start housing and supportive services for veterans with behavioral health needs
- [Life Tree Pharmacy](https://www.merakey.org/services/pharmacy): Life Tree Pharmacy: Merakey's medication management subsidiary
